reason: A DSH plugin that registers describe_image to read supported image files, optionally transcode them, and obtain text descriptions from a remote multimodal model.

summaries.zh: 通过远程多模态模型分析图片并返回文字描述的 DSH 视觉工具插件。
summaries.en: A DSH vision tool plugin that analyzes image files with a remote multimodal model and returns text descriptions.

capabilities: Reads image files through the DSH filesystem capability
Sends image data as base64 to configured external multimodal model endpoints
Optionally invokes ImageMagick through a subprocess capability and uses system temporary files for format conversion
May fall back from a free route to a paid model route
